raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: azure-mgmt-keyvault
  version: 11.0.0

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: fcfb1366852926f2a311e1bc6e6a786eb8a8a1fd46e6025d4c114ede2cb4642e

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . --no-deps --ignore-installed -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - azure-common >=1.1
    - azure-mgmt-core >=1.3.2
    - isodate >=0.6.1
    - typing-extensions >=4.6.0

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - azure
        - azure.mgmt
        - azure.mgmt.keyvault
        - azure.mgmt.keyvault.v2016_10_01
        - azure.mgmt.keyvault.v2016_10_01.models
        - azure.mgmt.keyvault.v2016_10_01.operations
      pip_check: false
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  summary: Microsoft Azure Key Vault Management Client Library for Python
  homepage: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python
  repository: https://github.com/Azure/azure-sdk-for-python
  documentation: https://docs.microsoft.com/python/api/overview/azure/key-vault

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - andreyz4k
    - janjagusch
